summary: Shiori is a self-hosted bookmark manager written in Go. It allows you to save web links, archive webpage content for offline reading, and organise your collection through tags. The application provides a lightweight alternative to commercial bookmarking services.
goodFor: Users who want a simple, containerised tool to store and index web links on their own infrastructure without heavy resource usage.
watchOut: The project shows slowing maintenance activity, which may impact timely responses to security vulnerabilities or bugs.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically requires persistent storage volumes for your saved data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
